overview:
**Very High fire danger holds today across the Montrose High Elevation zone, driven by critically dry fuels — ERC at 92% and BI at 94%, both above local thresholds.**
- Danger climbs further this week, reaching Extreme by Saturday as ERC rises toward the 98th percentile and humidity drops into single digits.
- Hot, dry, breezy conditions continue, with winds shifting N-NNE and afternoon relative humidity as low as 7-15% through the weekend.
- WATCHOUT conditions are active (4 of 7 thresholds exceeded); no Red Flag Warning is currently posted for the area.
- Montrose County entered Stage 1 fire restrictions Friday, August 2, while Ouray County has stage 2 fire restrictions in effect for all unincorporated areas; BLM Stage 1 restrictions also cover Montrose, Delta, Mesa, Gunnison, Ouray and San Miguel counties.
- Nearby: the Gold Mountain Fire has burned 39,507 acres and remains 67% contained near Ouray; the Elk Fire near Lake City is at 2,349 acres and 49% contained.
